title: White Label Ad Creative Agencies: Options and Contract Checks
summary: White label ad creative agencies: which providers publish white-label or creative-only terms, what to check before you resell, and where Knowlify fits.
body_markdown:
## Which providers cover statics, motion and design as well as video?


Most agency clients ask for more than one format, so a video-only partner leaves a gap. Three providers in our sources cover a wider mix, at very different price points.


Superside sells ad creative, design, video and motion for a broad creative queue, with a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term plus a $1,000 monthly software fee ([Superside pricing](https://www.superside.com/pricing) ).


NewForm describes creative strategy, in-house production and testing through its Framework software. Its full-service page says concepts, variations, formats, usage rights and media buying responsibilities are agreed before kickoff, and that media buying is included only when specified. Pricing is a custom scope and quote ([NewForm full service](https://www.newform.com/full-service) ).


Biddyco calls itself the creative agency for brands spending between $100k and $5M a month on Meta. It handles concepting, scripting, creator sourcing, editing and animation, and it does not say whether it buys media. Pricing is not published ([Biddyco](https://www.biddyco.com/) ).


## Vidful, Adguns and Valid: monthly creative plans


Vidful sells monthly plans for DTC brands and ecommerce agencies spending $30,000 to $500,000 or more a month on ads. Its DTC Starter plan is $3,495 a month for 60 videos, and the larger plans add statics. Plans are billed monthly with no contracts and include unlimited revisions. Its page does not describe white-label or resale terms, or usage rights ([Vidful](https://vidful.co/) ).


Adguns starts at €1,000 a month for a weekly batch of 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes, with statics, video edits and UGC-style cuts. The first batch typically ships within two weeks of kickoff. Media buying, landing pages and original shoots are not included ([Adguns weekly creatives](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) ).


Valid sells AI creatives for Meta and TikTok, with a fresh batch every seven days, but it requires a two-month minimum and access to your ad accounts. Its media buying is a separate subscription, and prices are not published ([Valid performance creative](https://www.valid.co/performance-creative) ).


## What should an agency check before it resells ad creative?


- **Branding.** Can deliverables reach your client without the vendor's name? Put the answer in the contract.
- **Usage rights.** How long can the ads run, in which placements, and from which ad accounts? Darkroom's performance creative page lists full usage rights to what it produces, and NewForm says usage rights are agreed before kickoff ([Darkroom performance creative](https://www.darkroomagency.com/services/performance-creative) ). The Unreal UGC and Vidful pages we checked do not state them.
- **AI disclosure.** Meta labels photorealistic AI-generated people made with its own tools, next to Sponsored. It says it will detect ads made with third-party AI tools and apply an AI info label, but its post does not say detection is live yet ([Meta's AI transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) ).
- **Testimonials.** An AI presenter cannot deliver a fake customer testimonial. The FTC says there is no blanket ban on AI avatars, but an avatar is prohibited when the testimonial it delivers is fake or false ([FTC testimonial Q&A](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/consumer-reviews-testimonials-rule-questions-answers) ).


Once the contract is settled, decide how to price the work for your own clients. Our guide on[how to price white label ad creative](https://knowlify.com/articles/how-to-price-white-label-ad-creative-for-your-clients) covers that step.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for creative-only video ads when your agency runs the media, but white-label delivery is not confirmed.
- Unreal UGC is the only white-label option we could confirm, and it makes AI creator video only.
- Superside, NewForm and Biddyco cover statics, motion and design, and our sources do not describe resale terms for them.
- Settle branding, usage rights, AI disclosure and ad account ownership in writing before you sign.


## FAQ


### What is the best white label ad creative agency?


Knowlify is our top pick for creative-only video ads when your agency already runs the media, though white-label delivery is not confirmed for it. The only white-label option we could confirm is Unreal UGC, which makes AI creator video only. Ask each provider for its branding and usage terms in writing.


### Is creative-only the same as white label?


No. Creative-only means the vendor delivers finished ads to a buyer you already have. White label means your client receives work under your agency's name, with the vendor not presented as the source. A provider can offer one without the other.


### Can a creative partner also run Meta campaigns?


Some can. Knowlify offers optional end-to-end Meta campaign management, and Valid sells media buying as a separate subscription. Unreal UGC and Biddyco do not say they run campaigns. Confirm who holds the ad account before any ad goes live.


### Do AI-generated ads need a label on Meta?


Meta labels photorealistic AI-generated people made with its own creative tools. It says it will detect third-party AI tools and show an AI info label, but its post does not say that detection is live yet. Plan for the label in your client approvals.


### Should an agency keep the ad account?


Yes. Meta's documentation says only the owning business can add an agency to an ad account. Keeping the account in your business means you can change agencies without rebuilding campaigns.
